plan.line: a capacitive soil moisture sensor (v1.2) on its 3-wire cable: tells how wet the soil in a plant pot is (a reading that goes down as the soil gets wetter; find the dry and wet values by testing). It has no bare metal, so it can stay in the soil. Uses one of the three ADC pins (shared with knobs).

code.pinLine: soil moisture sensor {ref} on {gpio}: ADC({g}). read_u16() is higher in dry soil (or air) and lower in wet soil; typical values on 3.3 V are around 50000 in air and 25000 in water, but every sensor differs: read it once in air and once in a glass of water, and scale between them (wet % = (dry - v) * 100 // (dry - wet)). Not Pin({g}): a Pin has no read_u16().
code.ragQuery: ADC analog input GP26 GP27 GP28 voltage range
